correctness.rationale: The five-cycle frustration sum forces at least n/2 unsatisfied antiferromagnetic edges, and equality forces every inner edge satisfied. The exact odd-outer-spin minimization reduces ground states for n=4r>=8 to 2 independent Ising signs and an independent set of C_(n/2). This proves E_min=-2nJ, 4 Lucas_(n/2) configurations, refined q-count 4m/(m-q) binom(m-q,q), zero inner/outer magnetizations, entropy log(phi)/4 per physical spin. Reconstructed the combinatorial proof and independently exhaustively checked all 2^16 n=8 configurations: energy -16 and 28 minimizers.
